pageCache.pageTitle: St Luke's C of E Primary School - Breakfast Club and After School Club
pageCache.text:
Breakfast Club and After School Club
Our Breakfast and After School Club is staffed by Gemma Racher, James Ellis, Caron Ellis, Jodie Cox and Pete Sells.
Our Breakfast Club is open from 7.45am - 8.45am every morning. Breakfast consisting of cereal, toast and orange juice is provided (up to 8.30am). The price per session is £5.
Our After School Club runs from 3.25pm -5.45pm every afternoon. Children will be offered a snack on arrival and a light tea between 4.45pm and 5pm. (Please note that if children are collected before 5pm, you should expect that they will not have had tea.) A range of fun activities are available. The price per session is £14.00.
Advance half termly booking is required. To enquire about booking a place at either Breakfast Club and / or After School Club, please email the office.
Terms and conditions
All parents will be emailed before the start of each new half term to invite them to indicate whether they would like to book any sessions at either Breakfast or After School Club.

pageCache.pageTitle: St Luke's C of E Primary School - School Uniform
pageCache.text:
School Uniform Policy
Where to Buy School Uniform
Our uniform can be purchased from specific retailers or more widely, including from our regular second hand FOSLSS uniform sales. Please refer to our school diary for dates of FOSLSS Second Hand Uniform Sales.
You can try on and buy uniform at the PMG Schoolwear shop in New Milton (you can also order uniform online at https://www.pmgschoolwear.co.uk/). You can also purchase school uniform online through: My Clothing at https://myclothing.com/st-lukes-church-of-england-primary-school/7576.school and Brigade at http://www.brigade.uk.com
Throughout the year, FOSLSS, our parent-teacher association runs second hand uniform sales after school. Dates of uniform sales are published in our school newsletters and in the diary section on our website. Gates open slightly earlier and uniform is available to buy before you collect your child(ren). Second hand items are £1 per item.
High Expectations
St. Luke's School has a uniform that all children are expected to wear it. We believe that wearing school uniform encourages children to be neat and tidy for work, prevents discrimination, reduces arguments about clothes at home, makes recognition of pupils easier and fosters a pride in our school. All children will be encouraged to keep themselves neat and tidy and to take pride in their general appearance.
Uniform - Summer
White, grey or navy socks
Black or blue shoes - NO TRAINERS
Uniform - Winter
Mid-grey skirt, pinafore, tunic or mid- grey trousers
Navy school sweatshirt or cardigan with school logo
White polo shirt or blouse (plain or with school logo)
White, grey or navy socks/ tights
Black or blue shoes - NO TRAINERS
For health and safety reasons, trainers, boots, slingbacks, open-toed sandals or high heeled shoes should not be worn in school, nor should children wear make up, nail varnish or jewellery.
Please refer to our School Shoes Expectation Document below for clarity about our expectation in relation to shoes.
Shoe Expectations.pdf
PE Kit
Navy shorts
Trainers - for outdoor use
Tracksuit - optional for cold weather
OPAL Play
To ensure children can enjoy our field year-round, we require those wishing to play on the grass during wet weather to have a pair of welly boots.
Storage: Boots can be kept at school in our dedicated Welly Boot Sheds located on the upper playground.
Protection: We also strongly recommend waterproof trousers or puddlesuits/onesies to keep school uniforms clean and dry while playing in muddy areas.
Art & Craft Activities
It is a good idea to provide your child with an old shirt or apron for protection when taking part in Art and Craft activities.
Jewellery
Children are not permitted to wear earrings or other jewellery. Plain studs are permitted for those children who have pierced ears. During PE, studs will need to be removed or covered with surgical tape. In general terms, you are advised not to allow your child to wear jewellery at school in case of loss, damage or injury.
ALL CLOTHING AND PERSONAL BELONGINGS SHOULD BE CLEARLY MARKED WITH YOUR CHILD'S NAME

pageCache.text:
SIMS Parent App and SIMS Activities
At St Luke's, we use the SIMS Parent App and website, a convenient way to share information with you about your child's life at St Luke's School.
You can access the system from a smartphone, tablet or PC - anytime, anywhere.
In our SIMS Parent App, you will find
If you have more than one child, you'll be able to have access to information for all your children, from the same app. The information that you receive through the app will help you to stay up-to date with your child's school life as well as support your child's development and progress.
messages
assessment information / your child's school report
Getting started with the SIMS Parent app
sims-parent-app-launch-letter.pdf
SIMS Activities
SIMS Activities – an easy way to sign up for extra-curricular activities
You can use SIMS Activities to view some of our extra-curricular activities quickly and easily.
You can access SIMS Activities from any internet – enabled device, including desktops, smart phones and tablets at https://parent.sims.co.uk
In Sims Activities, you will be able to
view a selection of school led extra-curricular activities, sports competitions and some clubs quickly and easily
instantly sign up to activities or provide consent
keep track of what activities you have signed up to
be notified instantly of any updates to activities (such as delays, cancellations or any changes to activity details.)
We use SIMS Activities to inform you of some of our sporting events and clubs run by school staff.
Therefore, if SIMS Activities is used for an activity, rather than receiving a paper based letter, you will receive a SIMS Activities invite email from norely@sims.co.uk with a link to SIMS Activities inviting you to accept or decline a place in a competition or club. Once logged in to SIMS Activities, you will be able to view full details of the activity and also be able to consent to your child taking part. There will not be a need to return a paper based slip and the school will be able to print out registers for activities directly from SIMS Activities. Very cleverly, SIMS Activities also includes on registers all the contact and medical details that are already in SIMS Parent App.
A guide for parents about SIMS Activities is available below.
We very much hope that both the SIMS Parent App and SIMS Activities will not only be easier and much more convenient for parents to use, but that they will both help us as a school to collect and manage data and extra-curricular activities much more efficiently.

pageCache.pageTitle: St Luke's C of E Primary School - School Lunches
pageCache.text:
School Lunches
School lunch menu from June 2026
Chartwells Summer 2026 Menu
'Pupils are developing a very good understanding of a healthy lifestyle' - OFSTED
School Meals
The school meals at St. Luke's School are cooked on the school site in the school kitchen and there is a choice of hot meals provided every day. Menus offer children the chance to have vegetables and fruit as part of their lunch. These are available to all children at a cost of £2.75 per day, i.e. £13.75 per week. Payment for hot school lunches should be made online at ParentPay.com (please contact the office if you need assistance with online payments). You will see when you log in to Parentpay, that you can order well in advance by clicking through the weeks.
Payment should be made in advance of receipt of meals. All school meals should be ordered for the week ahead by Sunday at midnight. Please ensure your child knows what you have ordered.
All children eat their lunch in the school hall or their classroom. A drink of water is always available. Some parents prefer that their children bring sandwiches to eat for lunch and they have the option to bring their own healthy packed lunch.
Food Allergies
Due to the increasing incidence of nut allergies amongst children, we ask children to exclude nuts or nut products in packed lunches. The school is a NUT FREE ZONE! Contact with nuts or nut products is potentially life threatening to children with nut allergies.
Universal Free School Meals
All children in the Infants, i.e. those children in Years R, 1 and 2 will automatically receive a hot school dinner, free of charge. This means that all children need to do each day is to choose from the menu (see link above).
There is no need to pay anything as the government have already provided schools with additional funding to cover this initiative. In support of this, although the take up of the free hot meals is not compulsory, unless we hear otherwise from individual parents, we will automatically provide all Infant children with a hot meal free of charge.
© St Luke's C of E Primary School, 2026 | Legal Information
